definitions.explanation: A jump-rope game in which two people swing a long rope while several others jump together inside it. A common schoolyard and sports-day activity in Japan.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}びをして{遊|あそ}んだ。
クラス{全員|ぜんいん}で{大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}びの{記録|きろく}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: The whole class took on the long-rope jumping record together.

examples.japanese: {運動会|うんどうかい}の{大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}びでは、{息|いき}を{合|あ}わせて{跳|と}ぶことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: In the long-rope jumping at sports day, it's important to jump in sync with each other.

notes:
A cooperative version of {縄跳|なわと}び in which a long rope is turned by two people while a group jumps together. Often a team event at school {運動会|うんどうかい} (sports days).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}びをする: to do group long-rope jumping
- {大|おお}{縄|なわ}を{回|まわ}す: to turn the big rope
- {大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}びの{記録|きろく}: long-rope jumping record
